description: Klaipėdos rajono savivaldybės vietinės reikšmės keliai (gatvės) is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klaipėdos rajono savivaldybės administracija. Cross road profile elements of Klaipėda district municipal road (street), protective fences, lighted areas, bus stops, railway crossings, speed-limiting hills, service facilities, road signs, obstacles above the road, curbs, parking and rest areas, sidewalks, pedestrian and maps of cycle paths, traffic lights, bridges, viaducts and overpasses, culverts. Coverage: Klaipėdos rajono savivaldybės administracija. The portal shows the English title as "Locally significant roads (streets) of Klaipėda district municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klaipėdos rajono savivaldybės administracija. Its keywords include Šviestuvai, Nuovažos, Pralaidos, Kliūtys, Autobusu Stotelės, Ženklai. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
